title: Columbia top 80 researchers — weighted coauthorship edges
description: One row per unordered pair of selected OpenAlex authors with a shared work (source ID < target ID). Weight is the distinct count of shared 2021–2024 snapshot works, regardless of either byline’s affiliation. cross_field compares the assigned fields and is unknown if either field is unknown.
code:
check=sql(base+''', inc AS (SELECT a.work_id,a.author_id,bool_or(a.is_columbia) AS affil,count(*) AS raw FROM authorships a JOIN selected USING(author_id) GROUP BY 1,2), work_sizes AS (SELECT work_id,count(*) AS n,count(*) FILTER (WHERE affil) AS m, sum(raw-1) AS duplicate_rows FROM inc GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS represented_works,sum(n) AS unique_incidences,sum(duplicate_rows) AS collapsed_rows,sum(n-m) AS non_columbia_incidences,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n>1) AS contributing_works,sum(n*(n-1)//2) AS pair_work_incidences,sum(n*(n-1)//2-m*(m-1)//2) AS pair_work_incidences_with_non_columbia_endpoint FROM work_sizes''')
print(check.to_string(index=False)); assert check.pair_work_incidences.iat[0]==edges.shared_work_count.sum()
print(nodes.loc[nodes.field_tie_size>1,['author_id','display_name','field_id','field','field_votes','field_tie_size']].to_string(index=False))
print(nodes[['field_strength','subfield_strength']].agg(['min','median','max']).to_string())
node_id=save_table(nodes,'Columbia top 80 researchers — ranked hierarchy nodes','One row per selected OpenAlex author, including isolates. Rank by distinct 2021–2024 snapshot work IDs with Columbia-system affiliation on the author’s own byline, across all work types; literal author-ID tie-break. Field and then nested subfield are plurality assignments from works.primary_topic_id on qualifying works, excluding missing topics and using numeric ID tie-breaks. Counts, conditional strengths, and tie sizes describe the assignment.')
edge_id=save_table(edges,'Columbia top 80 researchers — weighted coauthorship edges','One row per unordered pair of selected OpenAlex authors with a shared work (source ID < target ID). Weight is the distinct count of shared 2021–2024 snapshot works, regardless of either byline’s affiliation. cross_field compares the assigned fields and is unknown if either field is unknown.')
print(node_id,edge_id)
